why: A small back alley and service court behind a Downtown City Center shop and garage block: dumpster, crates, an arcade machine, a bench and a rain-soaked lane. In mq304 this is where V waits for Chester Bennett after his Arasaka meeting, with Bennett's driver leaning on the wall smoking and Bennett's Thrax parked at the alley mouth. Vanilla hides the alley clutter by default and only mq304 spawns the driver and car, so in normal play it is a bare, empty lane. This proposal restores the ordinary clutter and keeps the driver and his car as a plausible everyday wait, while the meeting itself, the boundary fence and the Aguilar-disguise actors stay out.

open_questions: Check the alley's ordinary clutter is visible: the arcade machine, bench, crates and dumpster, with no quest stage dressing. This is the arena 0 / hide 0 toggle; hide is 1 by vanilla default, so confirm the result looks like everyday street furniture rather than a quest set.

Check the driver: he should lean on the wall by the meeting house smoking and stay calm, not stand in a combat, cover or T-pose. If he looks wrong, the start phase's wall-lean workspot pairing is the first thing to re-check.
Check the Thrax: it should sit parked at the alley mouth about 35 m from the driver, level and clear of the lane, not floating, half-sunk or blocking the only way in.

Walk the alley from the street in both directions and confirm no invisible boundary, locked gate or blocked path stops you; the mq304 boundary variants live in the quest prefab we deliberately do not load.
Check the rest of the alley: no shard case, no body by the dumpster, no changing spot, and the arcade machine is not stuck unusable from the quest's ForceDisabled action.

communities.why: Bennett's driver waiting outside while his boss is inside is exactly what this alley is for and needs no quest: the start phase's one spot plays the wall-lean, cigarette-and-smoke workspot at (-2279.37, 487.22), by the meeting-house wall. His other phase, door, is the same man moved to the door trigger; start is the calmer, more natural wait and is the phase vanilla itself reactivates.

Bennett's Chevalier Thrax parked at the alley mouth makes the driver read as a driver rather than a man smoking in a lane. Vanilla spawns this entry in its start phase with the car at its own parking spot (-2284.13, 452.28), well clear of the lane and about 35 m from the driver; arrived is the later drive-up spot next to the door, which is the scene we do not want. The catalogue gives vehicles no posture, hence the tour check.

variant_toggles.why: Reveal the alley's ordinary dressing (arcade machine, bench with two sit spots, crates, air-conditioning units) while keeping the quest's arena stage off. The hide variant is the block default (1, i.e. the whole decoration hidden), and mq304 sets hide 0 + arena 1 for its scene; the cleanup phase sets the same hide 0 but ends with arena 0, which is the state this toggle reproduces. The arena group is the staged meeting set, so it stays off.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

proximity_wait.why: A security-area device at (-2279.4, 485.56, 7.3), the driver's own spot in the always-streamed gameplay section of the location, so it streams with the alley; a device entity, not a workspot. Its sibling #mq304_bennett_driver_sec_sys (1.6 m away) is the controller and an equally valid fallback, but the area device has a catalogue position and sits exactly where the people are.
